text:
Emma (Sales): LarkEdge just dropped a 40-question security questionnaire + request for SOC2 evidence for the POC. They want answers and docs by EOW. Who can own this?

Jordan (Security): I can own the questionnaire. Need clarity on which deployment we're proposing (hosted vs private) — a lot of questions hinge on that. @Miles can you confirm POC model and hosting?

Miles (PSE): POC is hosted API (Redwood hosted). Model: redwood-2-xl. POC will be low volume, token-limited. No VPC. Timeline: demo Thu. I can help with technical answers about request flow, API keys, rate limits.

Jordan (Security): ok hosted makes things easier. I'll handle control descriptions but need a list of required artifacts. @Sam where do I pull the SOC2 artifact and KMS diagram?

Sam (Platform): SOC2 report is in Confluence -> Compliance -> SOC2/2025 (internal link) https://confluence.redwood.example/compliance/soc2 KMS diagram attached in wiki. For quick answers: encryption at rest = AES-256 via cloud KMS, keys rotated quarterly, access via IAM roles. I'll paste a short snippet:

```
Encryption at rest: AES-256, managed KMS (Cloud-KMS), CMKs scoped per-customer.
Key rotation: automated quarterly, manual rotate available via console.
Access control: IAM + least privilege, key usage logged to audit logs.
```

Jordan (Security): thanks. I'll start mapping answers. A couple of tricky Qs: data residency (they asked EU), and vendor risk (subprocessors). Emma, is LarkEdge asking for EU-only hosting?

Emma (Sales): Yes, buyer legal flagged EU data residency. They said 'EU-hosted only' during contract call. Sales is ok to propose region eu-west-1 for the POC.

Miles (PSE): confirming we can pin region to eu-west-1 for hosted POC. No cross-region backups for POC unless requested.

Jordan (Security): great. I'll fill out questionnaire with that assumption and mark items that need supporting evidence. Expected ETA for first pass: tomorrow 10:00 PT.

Emma (Sales): perfect. Also pricing ask: they want POC pricing + discount for test tokens. @Miles can you draft a short POC price note I can send?

Miles (PSE): I'll draft: 2-week POC, up to 1M tokens, discounted rate $0.0004/token, support included. Will post doc in GH gist and link here.

deploy-bot: New ticket created SR-4821 (security-questionnaire-larkedge). Assigned to Jordan.

Jordan (Security): got SR-4821. I'll upload the completed Qs and artifact links there when done.

Emma (Sales): thanks team. Please @me when first pass is uploaded. If Jordan can't finish, escalate to @Sam. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Security): will do. Current plan: first pass tomorrow, artifacts linked, any open items flagged for sales/legal.
